entries.subject: Cassini ISS frames, 2018 shape release and radial elevation
entries.finding: [PDS calibrated Cassini ISS](https://pds-rings.seti.org/cassini/iss/calibration.html) frames, the [2018 shape release and controlled camera table](https://sbnarchive.psi.edu/pds4/cassini/saturn_satellite_shape_models_V1_0/document/helene_document.pdf) and shape-derived radial elevation supply the delivered views.

entries.subject: Two additional published-camera clear-filter frames
entries.finding: N1675163339_1 and N1519536732_1 expand sampled Monochrome physical-area coverage from 65.4% to 74.4%. Overlap-derived gains fit the measured 2.5 budget. The existing disconnected bright pair remains and now supplies about 35% of accepted area; this expansion does not repair its brightness discontinuity. Current-main browser qualification remains pending.

entries.subject: Selected calibrated Cassini filter-color observations
entries.finding: Two June 2011 IR3/IR1/UV3 sequences supply False color. Seven retained relative registration checks pass the existing independent RMS≤1 px and maximum≤2 px criteria; the original 8.4 px training outlier remains visible. These relative fits do not improve the source 150–300 m shape uncertainty.

entries.subject: Four additional June2011 Cassini clear views
entries.finding: N1687119135_1 adds roughly 44 m/pixel source sampling versus the earlier best58 m/pixel. N1687121164_1, N1687121224_1 and N1687121524_1 add nearby views. The recorded benefit is primarily detail/overlap, not large new coverage.

entries.subject: Level matching N1646319036_1 and N1646319549_1
entries.finding: These25–27-degree phase views overlap no other accepted frame. They remain selected but supply about 35% of displayed area at roughly 1.65 times the brightness; the later coverage expansion did not establish a level connecting them.
entries.revisitWhen: An overlapping controlled observation or source-backed photometric solution connects the pair to the other selected observations.
